title: Validation interview
description: One problem interview in the validation study, at <venture>/validation/interviews/<id>.json: who (anonymised), under what consent, what they said hurts, what they use now, the problem they chose, what the interviewer predicted with Naive and without it, and the follow-up that checks the prediction. The transcript itself stays in raw/ and is cited, never copied here.

person.description: An anonymised reference (p-07), never a name or contact detail; the key to the real person stays in a _private record

icp.description: The ideal customer profile id (foundation/icp/<id>.json) this person fits

transcript.description: The raw source the transcript lives in

source.description: A raw source id or venture path (raw/sources/<id>)

for.description: The bottleneck it is used for

chosen_problem.description: The one bottleneck the person chose to work on

with_naive.description: What the interviewer predicts happens with Naive

status_quo.description: What the interviewer predicts happens without it

evidence.description: Evidence record ids behind the outcome
